DisplayName.value: Kitsune Loads ~ Cats of 7 Days: Christmas

Description.value: Cats of 7 Days, the holiday special: the tabby keeps Christmas while the zombies try to join in. 12 widescreen scenes (zombie Santa at the window, scrap tree, stockings, minibike sleigh, trader, gift-wrapped airdrop, frozen snowman, carolers at the gate, chimney, Christmas feast, horde night, gyrocopter) rotate at random every time the loading screen appears. Mutually exclusive with the other KitsuneLoads packs ~ install one or the other.
